title: IVG Intense Salts Banana Ice 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Banana Ice combines the mellow sweetness of ripe Bananas with a crisp layer of Ice. The Banana flavour is fruity, while the cooling edge keeps the profile fresh and balanced. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt ensures clear flavour delivery, discreet vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Banana Ice is designed for mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, starter devices, and vape pens. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Banana Ice offers a fruity sweetness with a refreshing chill.
